description: Metric vectors. trunc6 truncates an exact decimal to millionths. Retention R_u (millionths) is the minimum truncated audienceWatchRatio over the samples inside [segmentStartSec/durationSec, segmentEndSec/durationSec] plus the nearest sample strictly before and strictly after, capped at 1,000,000; null when no sample exists. Integration metric q = views x R_u div 1,000,000.

retention.name: segment-spans-samples
retention.description: Samples 0.25-0.35 lie inside [xs, xe] = [0.25, 0.35]; 0.24 and 0.36 are the nearest outside.

retention.name: segment-between-samples
retention.description: No sample lies inside [0.123, 0.124]; only the nearest samples 0.12 and 0.13 count.

retention.name: segment-at-start
retention.description: No sample lies before xs = 0; J is 0.01-0.10 plus the next sample 0.11.

retention.name: segment-at-end
retention.description: No sample lies after xe = 1; J is 0.90-1.00 plus the previous sample 0.89.

retention.name: bounds-are-inclusive
retention.description: xs = 0.33 and xe = 0.50 are samples themselves, so they are inside; 0.32 and 0.51 are the nearest outside.

retention.name: exact-rational-bounds
retention.description: xs = 1/3 exactly, so 0.33 is the nearest sample before and 0.32 (the curve minimum) is excluded. Rounding xs to 0.33 would wrongly include 0.32.

retention.name: ratio-above-one-is-capped
retention.description: Every ratio in J is above 1, so R_u is capped at 1,000,000.

retention.name: no-samples
retention.description: Without samples J cannot be formed, so the item is not measurable.

integration.name: spec-13-retention
integration.description: Section 13 example: V = 123,457 and minimum ratio 0.4567891234.
